'''Ter-Doac Vaine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], it was discovered that Ter-Doac had been [[Mind trick/Legends|mind-controlling]] [[Garrick Orion]] and [[Jonas Nova]] in an attempt to cause a [[Nova Orion Crisis|rift]] in the [[Nova Orion Industries]]. Ter-Doac's goal was to get [[Nova Orion Station]] to build weapons for his campaign to take control of the [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|renegade Imperial Star Destroyer]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ter-Doac Vaine appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ter-Doac Vaine was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Nova Orion Main Quest Guide|"Nova Orion" quest series]] introduced in the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]],<ref name="SWG:EG" /> released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> His physical appearance could be seen briefly when he threatened a spacer via comm channel.<ref name="SWG:EG" /> The game files reveal that his right hand was [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]], however as his hand was not seen during normal gameplay, the [[canon]]icity of this attribute is ambigious.
